name: Emergency Diesel Generator A Failure (standalone)
description: Emergency diesel generator A is declared unavailable (e.g. maintenance lockout). The plant continues at power, but a subsequent loss of off-site power would leave only train B. This scenario then imposes that LOOP so the operator sees single-train response.
briefing: Diesel A is out of service from t+5 s. Off-site power is then lost at t+40 s. Confirm diesel B alone re-energises the essential bus.
learning_objectives: Technical-specification style equipment availability and its consequences
The difference between a diesel that failed and one that was never started

events.label: Emergency diesel generator A out of service
